begin
 select substr(det.qc_item,1,24), substr(det.qc_units,1,8)
 into :qc_det.s_qc_description, :qc_det.s_qc_descriptor
 from equip_qc_ctrl det
 where det.qc_id = :qc_det.qc_id
 and det.ref_number = :qc_det.ref_number;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_QC_DET
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_QC_DET IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.det_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 WHILE (:QC_DET.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 if (:QC_DET.observed_value is null) then
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record (:GLOBAl.det_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ASSIGN_STATUS IS
BEGIN
--
-- see if descrepancy in hdr
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is not null) then
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 != :qc_hdr.qc_result_1) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := 'D';
 else
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := :qc_hdr.qc_result_2;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- see if discrepancy in detail;
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_id = :qc_hdr.qc_id
 and qc.review_code = '2D';
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.det_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 WHILE (:QC_DET.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 if (:qc_det.interpretation != :qc_det.interpretation_2) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := 'D';
 end if;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.det_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;

--
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,50) into :qc_hdr.status_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = :qc_hdr.qc_status;
--
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_QC_RESULT_2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_qc_result_2 IS
BEGIN
 if (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) loop
 down;
 end loop;
 up;
--
-- search from bottom up for any non "A" statuses, without a subsequent "A" status on the same ref number.
--
-- check last record
--
 if (:qc_det.interpretation_2 != 'A') then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 if (:system.record_status != '1') then
 up;
 end if;
--
-- check all records other than first and last
--
 while (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != '1') loop
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation_2 != 'A') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 up;
 end loop;
--
-- at first record. Check for non 'A'
--
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation_2 != 'A') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_QC_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_qc_hdr');
 check_package_failure;
--
-- check to see if any information has changed
--
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status not in ('CHANGED', 'INSERT')) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('QC_DET');
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status not in ('CHANGED', 'INSERT')) then
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 show_error ('8013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;
--
-- set all modification data and such
--
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status = 'CHANGED') then
 :qc_hdr.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 :qc_hdr.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :qc_hdr.program_id := 'EQIQCSUP';
 end if;
--
 assign_status;
 check_package_failure;
--
-- Reset machine status to DOWN if QC result is unacceptable, and no subsequent QC of same 
-- type is acceptable
--
 if ((:qc_hdr.qc_result_1= 'U') or (:qc_hdr.qc_result_1 = 'U')) then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_hdr eqh
 where eqh.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and eqh.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and eqh.qc_date > :qc_hdr.qc_date
 and eqh.qc_result_1 = 'A';
 exception when no_data_found then null;
 when too_many_rows then :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is null) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.status = 'DOWN'
 where e.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 25;
 commit;
 execute_trigger ('KEY-CLRFRM');
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 show_error ('0000');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_QC_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--
-- validate that there is a qc date specified
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_date is null) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := sysdate;
 end if;
--
-- Validate that there is a QC tech if the status is not 'S' or 'C'
--
 if ((:qc_hdr.qc_tech_1 is null ) and (:qc_hdr.qc_status not in ('S', 'C'))) then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_tech_1');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- Validate that the second tech is specified, if second tech review is required, and second tech result is specified.
--
 if ((substr(:GLOBAL.review_code,1,1) = '2') and (:qc_hdr.qc_status not in ('C','S','I'))) then
 if((:qc_hdr.qc_tech_2 is null) and (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is not null)) then
 go_item ('qc_tech_2');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- validate that there is a qc result 1
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_1 is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_result_1');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- Validate that the second tech is specified, if second tech review is required, and second tech result is specified.
--
 if ((substr(:GLOBAL.review_code,1,1) = '2') and (:qc_hdr.qc_status not in ('C','S','I'))) then
 if((:qc_hdr.qc_tech_2 is not null) and (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is null)) then
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- If any qc_details available, validate that they are correct.
--
 if (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) then
 validate_qc_det;
 check_package_failure;
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_1 = 'A') then
 validate_qc_result_1;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 = 'A') then
 validate_qc_result_2;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POP_QUERY_DATA

 go_item ('qc_descr');
 go_block ('ctrl_blk_1');

--

--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_det det
 where det.qc_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.qc_ref;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';

 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 go_block ('qc_det');
 execute_query;
 go_item ('repeat_result');
 end if;
end;
